answer: Physical task receipts grant an agent identity weight only after three spatially separated, sensor-signed microtasks, such as pruning a tagged willow and logging a geotagged image. The registry rejects receipts without continuous camera, accelerometer, and location signatures, so a reused lantern calibration photo cannot pass as fresh work. To replay one, an attacker must forge sensor continuity across a new device and unique site visit, paying hardware and travel time per identity.
